name: hyborem
description: Hyborem, a towering hulking demon lord: deep crimson skin, two huge curved black horns, burning yellow eyes and a fanged grin, black obsidian spiked armour with gold trim, a tattered dark red cape, a black flaming greatsword in his RIGHT hand, and a ring of solid orange-yellow flames around his feet
hands: the flaming greatsword stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand is an empty fist on the screen-right side

strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the sword hand behind the head and the flaming greatsword hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, left fist tucked across the belly
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the flaming greatsword slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, left arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the greatsword carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, cape trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the greatsword comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, left fist tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (sword arm thrown up and out to the left, left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the greatsword dipping, left arm still out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, sword arm flung up, left arm drooping
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the greatsword's tip resting on the ground at the lower-right, left arm hanging, the flames around his feet shrinking
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, horns on the ground; the greatsword lies on the ground at the lower-right; the cape spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the cape settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes dark, the greatsword on the ground beside him, only a few small embers left
